cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They're calling your audition number. We'll go in now; I'll do the introductions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want the part. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose: I'll walk you in, or drive you home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay beside you. The rest I can't promise. Are we going in?

reason: Remove appended status language; A leads entry, yields the decision and negotiates the only support A can actually guarantee.
